sections.text_helper: Section 16.5 "EXTI event protection" in chapter 16 (Extended interrupts and event controller (EXTI)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 451.
sections.section_content:
The EXTI is able to protect event register bits from being modified by unprivileged accesses.
The protection is individually activated per input event via the register bits in
EXTI_PRIVCFGR. At EXTI level, the protection consists in preventing the following
unauthorized write access:
• Change the settings of the privileged configurable events.
• Change the masking of the privileged input events.
• Clear pending status of the privileged input events.
[Table 105. Register protection overview]
